scripts.dev: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; elif command -v uvicorn >/dev/null 2>&1; then uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; else python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload; fi'
scripts.start: bash -c 'if [ -f .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; elif command -v uvicorn >/dev/null 2>&1; then uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi'
